lines.en: label undeservedfuture1:
scene undeservedfuture1
: What?...
scene undeservedfuture2
: Where...
: Where...am I?
scene undeservedfuture3
: And...
: Why are my boobs so much bigger all of a sudden?
: It’s not just your boobs, Ayane...Everything about you is bigger all of a sudden.
scene undeservedfuture4
: Sensei! Thank God...You’re still here. What do you mean by “everything,” though? Himawari’s door didn’t make me gain weight, did it?
: No, you’re just...
: You look...older.
scene undeservedfuture5
: And you look...
scene undeservedfuture6
: ...Exactly the same.
: A little closer to eye level, sure. But frankly, I think it’s extremely unfair for only one of us to change. At least get a new outfit or something.
: And stop just staring at me like that. I haven’t seen myself in the mirror yet. I’m self-conscious.
: Ayane...I think that door somehow took us to the future.
: The future? Is that where we are right now? How do you know? Apart from me just looking older, that is.
scene undeservedfuture7
: Well, for one, that calendar on the desk says it’s 2035. And, according to my calculations, that would mean we are suddenly fifteen years past where we were five minutes ago.
: Ha!
scene undeservedfuture8
: Ha? What do you mean, “ha?”
: What do you think I mean, Sensei? If we’re still together fifteen years later, it obviously means I was right about you being my future husband! I won in the end!
: Assuming this actually is the end, of course. But, knowing our luck, I imagine this illusion will shatter in a matter of minutes and we’ll go back to being sad and fifteen years younger.
: Yeah...maybe.
: Okay. Seriously, though? Stop staring at me like that. I haven’t gotten to know my grown-up self yet.
: It’s...uhh...
scene undeservedfuture9
: Uhh what? What does that mean? That isn’t helping.
: You’re, like...extremely hot.
: Okay, now it’s helping. Please continue.

: The thoughts kind of cut off there. There’s a level of shell-shock one can expect after suddenly being thrown so far into the future and coming face-to-face with an aged-up version of a person they’ve had sex with over a thousand times.
scene undeservedfuture10
: So...do we, like...live here then? Is this our house?
: I know just as much as you, Ayane. The only difference is I saw the calendar first.
scene undeservedfuture11
: What if it’s just...over?
: What? What if what’s over?
: Everything. Like, what if that door just...saved us instead of delaying the apocalypse or whatever it was supposed to do?
: I’d say that’s...a pretty anticlimactic ending to everything we’ve gone through. And that it would have been nice if that girl showed up like five years earlier.
: Well, what do we do now then?

: Because both my nerves and my mind are going a little too crazy right now to have sex. And it seems like that’s what you want to do based on how you’re still looking at me like a vulture eyeing its next meal.
scene undeservedfuture12
: I don’t think it’s far off to confirm that’s essentially how I’m feeling as well.
: My feelings are slightly more conflicted. I can’t tell yet if I like being almost the same size as you. I’m, like...way tall for a Japanese girl now, aren’t I?
: Yeah. But you’ve never really looked Japanese to begin with, so I still haven’t ruled out that you were just switched at birth or something.
: I’ve got to admit — and I know we’ve only been here for a couple minutes, but this is way nicer than I expected.
: You’re not planning on turning into Horseface Taki and making me build another go-kart, are you?
: Not at the moment, no. I’ll let you know if that changes, though.
: Cool, thanks. Also, are you just going to stare at my boobs for this entire conversation? Or what?
: They’re so big now.
scene undeservedfuture13
: Right?
: Not gonna lie, I’m kind of excited to check them out during my bath tonight.
: So we just...live here now then? Settle in? Not going to think about escaping or going back to normal at all? Just...relax and treat this like reality when it’s anything but?
scene undeservedfuture14
: I don’t know yet. But don’t you think we should maybe try and enjoy this if it really is the future? Who knows when we might get another chance to experience such a thing?
: I get what you’re saying. I just don’t think we should let ourselves get too attached since it’ll make inevitably leaving that much harder.
scene undeservedfuture15
: Sensei, I know better than to let myself get attached to anything at this point. Well, anything other than you at least. I’ll be fine. Don’t worry.
: How about you, though? Will you feel better or worse looking at teenage Ayane again knowing that she winds up super stacked and super tall?
: Good question. I’ll let you know when I come up with an answer.
: Want to do a little exploring then? See what kind of future we’ve found ourselves in? Our bedroom’s pretty nice, so I’m excited to see the rest of the house.
: You really won’t get attached?
scene undeservedfuture16
: Sensei, I’m fine. Really. I-
: Because I know this is your dream, Ayane. And I want to indulge you, but I also worry about you.
scene undeservedfuture17
scene undeservedfuture18
: But...I guess there’s no reasonable alternative since just indefinitely staying in this room doesn’t sound feasible at all. And also because I have bad experiences with that exact thing.
: We can explore, then?! What do you think we have in the fridge?! Oh! I wonder if there’s a garden we could-
: Don’t talk to me about gardening right now. I’ve had bad experiences with that too.
: It’s not my fault you keep having so many bad experiences, you know.
scene black
: Come on. Let’s see what the rest of this place looks like. Figure out whether or not it really is the house of your dreams.
: Heheh...I can already tell you it is.
scene undeservedfuture19
: Because the house of my dreams is any house I live in with you. The rest of the details don’t matter to me in the slightest.
: It’s comforting knowing you still feel that way all the way over here in 2035. Now I don’t have to worry about your feelings for me expiring.
: Some things never change, Sensei. My feelings for you are the prime example of that.
: I can tell by the fact that you’re still calling me “Sensei” despite us likely being married at this point.
scene undeservedfuture20
: You’re not going to torture me about that again, are you? It was embarrassing enough as a teenager. Not being able to call you Akira as an adult would be-
scene undeservedfuture21
: MMMMPH?!?!
: See? You did it just fine right there. No problems at all apart from the fact that you are...also now beet-red.
: But how did...
: It came out so easily all of a sudden.
scene undeservedfuture22
: This is just a mildly educated guess, but...maybe it’s easier in this world since that’s likely what you were already calling me here before we swapped in?
: “Swapped in?” So you think this is an actual future rather than one that’s just...made up?
: I think that’s the cuter answer that will make you happier to hear and give you the motivation to keep pushing through the quagmire that is life itself.
: So you are lying for the sake of my happiness?
: I am not answering that question. Again, for the sake of your happiness.
scene undeservedfuture23
: In that case, I will just smile and go along with it for the sake of our alleged marriage. Finally, my arc as an alleged perfect housewife can begin.

: You can leave out the “alleged” part from now on. I’m not heartless enough to see this and not also want to sort of just...be swallowed up by it rather than thinking of what’s on the other side of the door.
scene undeservedfuture24
: It’s a nice house, isn’t it? We probably do pretty well for ourselves.
: You probably do pretty well. I can’t imagine I do anything at all.
: I hope you clean at least. I love you, but I don’t want to be the breadwinner and the one who does all of the chores.
: I changed my mind. I want to go back to our world where Ami just does everything for me.
scene undeservedfuture25
: Ooh! Speaking of Ami, do you think we’re still in touch with anyone from high school in this world?
: As a husband, I certainly hope not. Because I love you, but you know I struggle with loyalty.
: I love you too. And yes, you are a whore.
scene undeservedfuture26
: But, unfortunately for both of us, my curiosity has been piqued and I must now find out.
: Ayane-
: And we’re off to a bad start already because I just scrolled all the way through “A” and Ami is no longer in my contacts.
: That’s...sort of worrying considering how you two would be literally related if you and I were to get married. Which we apparently did since I removed the “alleged” part.
: Who are literally any of these people? It’s all names I’ve never seen before.
: One just says “groomer.” Do we have a dog now or something?
: I hope so because the only alternative I can think of would be a very rude but also sadly accurate nickname for your husband.
: Yeah, Akira, I’m not seeing any-
scene undeservedfuture27
: Ah! Sana! Sana’s still in my phone! Sara too!
: Huh...I guess that makes sense. I wonder what she’s doing fifteen years after high school, though?
scene undeservedfuture28
: Well, worry no longer because I’m going to find out. Here’s hoping that I haven’t done anything in the last fifteen years to upset her.
: You mean like marrying the guy she likes?
: It’s been a decade and a half. I doubt Sana still likes you that way. Especially if you and I are-
scene undeservedfuture29
: Hello?
: S...Sana! Hi! How are you? Where are you? How’s the last decade been?
scene undeservedfuture30
: Oh, Ayane. Hey. Does Akira not have his phone on him or something? I’ve been texting him all morning and he hasn’t answered.
: Fuck! You were right!
: Told you.
: Oh, are you with him right now? Then, could you tell him to check his messages? It’s about that book he recommended me a few months ago. I finally got around to reading it and-
: Forget the book! As my best friend, can I ask you to do something no questions asked? It’s really important.
scene undeservedfuture31
: I mean...sure. But the last time you asked me to have a threesome, you told me I was being way too clingy with Akira and that I couldn’t just-
: Ahhhhhh! Stop! No! I don’t want to hear about that! Just fill me in on the last ten to fifteen years of both of our lives!
scene undeservedfuture32
: Huh? Why? I’m working. I don’t have time for a recap episode that long.
: Then please answer the following questions! Are Akira and I married? Why don’t I have Ami’s number anymore? When did my boobs get so big?
: Yes to the marriage thing. For Ami, I don’t know — but probably some personal stuff involving Akira.
: And, uhh...I think your boobs started ballooning around the end of freshman year. But that’s also when you moved away, so I didn’t really get to keep tabs on their development and-
scene undeservedfuture33
: Moved? We moved? To where?
: To Aomori...
: Aomori?...
: Ayane, is something wrong? Did you, like...hit your head or something? What’s going on? You’re worrying me.
scene undeservedfuture34
: Sana says we moved to Aomori...
: Aomori?...Why would we move all the way over there? And — better question — how did we move all the way over there?
scene undeservedfuture35
: Sana...is the barrier around Kumon-mi gone now? Or did we just find a way to-
: Ayane, that thing has been gone for fifteen years. They tore it down once we lost the space war.
: Seriously? Just like that? But our lives practically revolved around that thing for years. And I loved Kumon-mi. So why did I leave?
: Akira’s still with you, isn’t he? Just ask him. It was his idea.
: He’s confused too. Both of our brains are kind of, uhh...not perfect right now. Which is why I need to rely on you to just tell me everything ever. So if you know anything at all...please, just-
: Himawari.
scene undeservedfuture36
: Himawari? You know her too? How?
: H...How?
: Because...uhh...
: She’s your daughter?...
scene undeservedfuture37
: What?
: What did I just hear?
: Sana — what did Akira just hear? What did I just hear?
: Ugh...Ayane, I’m sorry, but we’re super busy right now. Can I just call you tonight?
: No. You will stay on the phone and repeat what you just told me. Over and over again until I believe it.
scene undeservedfuture38
: Ugh...Ayane...
: Mom! Dad! I’m home!
: Never mind! Something came up! Bye!
scene undeservedfuture39
: So, I know you guys are all for me being independent and spreading my wings or whatever it is you want to call it...
: But, I’ve given it some thought, and I’ve decided that it would be in all of our best interests if I just spend the rest of my life under this roof with you guys.
: I’ll be dropping out tomorrow. Daddy can teach me from now on. He has nothing else to do, so I’m sure it will be mutually beneficial to both of us.
scene undeservedfuture40
scene undeservedfuture41
: Did I accidentally interrupt “adult time” again?
: What...did you just call me?
: Hm? Daddy.
: It’s what I always call you when I want you to do something for me. And, in this case, that “thing” is furthering my education. My future is in your hands, Father.
scene undeservedfuture42
: I apologize for the interruption. I will go into my room and put my headphones on now. You won’t even know I’m here.
: Himawari...
scene undeservedfuture43
: Whatever I’m in trouble for, he’s the one who made me do it! I was under duress, I say! I had no choice! I regret everything!
: You are...
: Our daughter...
scene undeservedfuture44
: You’re not about to tell me I’m actually adopted, are you? Because I won’t believe it. Even if I am provided with evidence.
: I have a daughter...
scene undeservedfuture45
: Akira and I...have a daughter...
: A beautiful daughter...
: Who can also...travel through time?...
: I mean...
: I am pretty great. But I think you might be talking me up just a little too much there, Mom.
: I should have known the moment I saw you...
: How did I not realize it?...
: To be fair, you were probably so hopped up on pain meds during labor that you wouldn’t have recognized yourself even if you gave birth next to a mirror.
: What’s with this sudden burst of sentimentality, though? And why does it seem like Dad is broken now? Did Niki Nakayama just announce a comeback tour or something?
: He’s probably...just in shock, Himawari...
: We’ve had a...very eventful day...
scene undeservedfuture46
: Ugh...tell me about it. I haven’t eaten a thing since breakfast this morning and am probably going to just die if I am not fed within the next hour.
scene undeservedfuture47
: So, unless you guys want a surprise visit from CPS, I think the time has come to provide for the little girl you created via carnal sin! Sound good, Dad?
: Father dearest? Your angel is speaking to you. If you keep neglecting her like this, she might scorn you for the rest of her life and grow up with a slew of personal issues.
: You don’t want to be held responsible for that, do you?
scene undeservedfuture48
: Is he okay, Mom? I haven’t seen him this pale since Aunt Ami gave me one of her poetry anthologies for Christmas a few years ago.
: Akira...snap out of it...
: Now’s not the time to start blacking out again...
: Look at her...just look at her. She’s ours! Who cares if it’s not real?! Who cares if-
scene black
: D-Dad?!
: What...uhh...ambulance! My bag! My phone is in my-
: Akira! Wake up! Don’t ruin this! Please!
: M-Mom! Did you just slap him?! Isn’t that a little-
: HE NEEDS TO WAKE UP!
scene fatherhood
$ undeservedfuture1 = True
jump undeservedfuture2
